linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620, AMD Radeon R7 240, or NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 (OpenGL 4.3 or Vulkan support required)
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan-compatible GPU for optimal performance. Targeting 30 FPS on low settings in 720p.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit) or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti, AMD Radeon RX 560, or better (Vulkan support required)
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan-compatible GPU for optimal performance. Targeting 30 FPS on low settings in 720p.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 or AMD Radeon R7 240 (Shader Model 4.0 or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low settings with 30 FPS in 720p resolution
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: High settings with 100 FPS in 3840p resolution.
